app.name: WiiBrowser Lite (development)
app.long_description: Development snapshot, not release-cleared. Basic HTML/CSS, HTTP/HTTPS, links, URL-encoded forms, bookmarks and SD/USB downloads. Keep the included cacert.pem beside boot.dol. Wii Remote: point/A, D-pad, B+IR scrolling, Plus/Minus toolbar, HOME exit. Console RESET returns to Wii Menu; POWER shuts down. PNG/JPEG only. No JavaScript, uploads, extraction, updater, forwarder or video. See README for limitations, verification status and .part/.new/.bak recovery.
